rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something gradually disappears, grows dim, or fades into the distance.

example.english: The light in the distance slowly begins to fade into the fog.
example.traditional: 遠處盞燈慢慢消失喺霧入面。
example.jyutping: jyun5 cyu3 zaan2 dang1 maan6 maan6 siu1 sat1 hai2 mou6 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this specifically when a color, brightness, or freshness becomes weaker.

example.english: This shirt will fade after a few more washes.
example.traditional: 呢件衫洗多幾次就褪色喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 sai2 do1 gei2 ci3 zau6 tan3 sik1 laa3

rows.note: Use this causative construction when something makes an object's color or brightness fade.

example.english: Strong sunlight makes the poster fade.
example.traditional: 猛烈嘅陽光令張海報褪色。
example.jyutping: maang5 lit6 ge3 joeng4 gwong1 ling6 zoeng1 hoi2 bou3 tan3 sik1
